name: plexi-spine-assets
description: - `Plexi_original_full_reference.png` — original user-supplied transparent PNG, preserved unchanged. - `Plexi_head_shoulders_reference.png` — crop of the original for head/shoulders work; reference only. - `Plexi_face_reference.png` — crop of the original face; reference only. - `Plexi_expression_reference_sheet.jpg` — generated visual reference for speech shapes, blinking and expressions. It has a background and is NOT a production sprite atlas or transparent cutout set. - `CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT.md` — detailed implementation brief for Claude Code.
